job.name: ig39_sea
job.style: Photorealistic travel photo, bright natural daylight, true-to-life colours. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
job.style_qa: фотореализм, женщина сидит на скалах у бурного синего моря, солнечно, без надписей
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary woman (not a celebrity), seen from a distance, face partly turned to the sea.
job.meaning: вступление: женщина спокойно сидит на скале у моря, настрой
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic travel photo. A woman about 40 in a black beanie, sunglasses, white wide trousers and a black knitted vest sits barefoot and relaxed on big grey coastal rocks, knees up, arms resting on knees, chin lifted towards the sun, a calm proud smile, looking out over a wild deep-blue sea with white surf crashing below. Bright sunny day, a blue sky with soft white clouds, green coastal grass in the foreground. She is in the lower middle of the frame, small-to-medium size; the upper third of the frame is open sky and sea. Real camera photo, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
